1364793.name: Kitchen
1364793.notes: Communal kitchen. Counters along both long walls (modelled); fridge in the north-east corner; sink in the middle of the west counter (modelled); a microwave on each counter; kettles, a coffee machine and other tabletop appliances. Communal, so not everyone uses them: many prefer a personal appliance. The door from crit room 1 leads through a pass-through doorway (no panel) in the wall across the kitchen; the doorway to the lounge has no panel either.

1364796.name: Student lounge
1364796.notes: Student lounge, a bay of the studio open to it on the south and part of the west. Good Times and Waffle Times happen here. Fridge in the north-east corner. On the west side, against the full-height service shaft, the bar: two beers on tap, a counter longer than the model shows, with the keg fridge at its south end. A couch by the east glass with a coffee table in front (the model's 'Bench2'). Along the studio desks on the south edge, church-pew benches with a high back against the desks. The doorway to the kitchen has no panel (edits E1). Open to the studio on the south and the west half: nothing marks the edge but the back of the pew bench and the backs of the studio desks. The long piece along the kitchen wall is a kitchen- or bar-height serving table; the piece along the glass north of the couch is another couch or bench. Everyday use: lunch, social space, group work. The Good Times and Waffle Times schedule comes with the handover document.

1364799.notes: The studio: sixteen bays of eight desks along the west glass with a board and a side table at the end of each (the board more a divider), smaller groups on the east. Desks and boards are on casters, not typically moved during the semester (movable with the movable_furniture toggle). Cohorts: the eastern desks and the southernmost area third years, the middle first years, the northernmost second years, generally; exact ratios in the handover note. Printing is concentrated at the north end for the whole floor: two plotters, three large printers (8.5x11 and 11x17), and the desktop computers mid-floor that send jobs to the plotters, all used by all students. Presence over time comes with the handover. Service shafts and similar are not occupiable.
